brandGuide.title: Mersal — the messenger
brandGuide.intro: Mersal (مرسال) is the messenger who carries something to the person it belongs to. The identity is calm and trustworthy, with the warmth of the Mediterranean that connects our routes.
brandGuide.logoBody: A lowercase m drawn as a two-leg route: origin, hand-off to a traveller, arrival. The terracotta point marks the destination.
brandGuide.colorBody: White-led layouts with Deep Sea text and teal actions. Terracotta is an accent for icons and illustration — never for long text.
brandGuide.typeBody: Readex Pro for headings in both Latin and Arabic scripts; IBM Plex Sans and IBM Plex Sans Arabic for interface text.
brandGuide.typeSample: Your parcel travels with someone already going.
brandGuide.voiceBody: Clear, warm, reassuring. Short sentences. We explain what happens next and never compare ourselves with others.
voiceDoItems: You will be charged €24.50. Nothing else.
We hold the payment until delivery is confirmed.
brandGuide.themeBody: Every colour, radius and name comes from one brand configuration. Switch themes to preview the platform in a partner's identity.

help.title: Questions, answered.
help.subtitle: Short answers about sending, travelling, payments and safety.

price.a: Each route has a published tariff: a price per weight band, applied to whichever is greater, the real weight or the volumetric weight (length × width × height ÷ a set divisor). The category, declared value, speed and extras then adjust it. You see each line before you pay.

noMatch.q: What if no traveller takes my parcel?
noMatch.a: Your parcel is proposed to suitable travellers one after another. If nobody accepts in time, we let you know: you can try again with new dates or cancel for a full refund.

cancel.a: Yes, until the traveller picks the parcel up, and your payment is refunded in full. After pickup, use “Report a problem” if something goes wrong.

recipient.q: Does my recipient need an account?
recipient.a: No. They receive a private tracking link and the delivery code by text message or email, and give the code to the traveller on arrival.

who.a: Anyone aged 18 or over with a confirmed email address and phone number. Our team reviews your identity document and selfie before your first trip.

choose.q: Do I have to accept every parcel?
choose.a: No. Each offer shows the parcel, its size and what you will earn, and you can decline it. Offers left to expire lower your response rate, which matching takes into account.

check.q: Can I check what’s inside a parcel?
check.a: Yes, and you should. Before entering the pickup code, check that the parcel matches its description and photos. If it doesn’t, or if it holds anything prohibited, don’t take it: withdraw from the parcel in the app.

withdraw.a: You can withdraw from a parcel until you pick it up, and it goes back to matching for another traveller. Withdrawals lower your reliability score, so let us know as early as you can.

when.a: When you confirm your shipment, before we look for a traveller. Mersal holds the money and releases it to the traveller only after delivery.

methods.a: By card, through Stripe. Mersal never sees or stores your card number.

refund.a: Refunds go back to the card you paid with. They usually appear within 5 to 10 working days, depending on your bank.

payout.q: How do travellers receive their earnings?
payout.a: Add a payout account in your wallet. Earnings unlock {holdHours} hours after delivery and are sent every {weekday} in a single transfer. If a transfer fails, our team retries it once your details are updated.

problem.q: Something went wrong. What do I do?
problem.a: Open the shipment and choose “Report a problem” within {disputeHours} hours of delivery, or earlier if the parcel is late or hasn’t arrived. The traveller’s earnings stay frozen while our team reviews the case, and you both see the decision.

chat.q: Why are phone numbers hidden in the chat?
chat.a: To protect both sides and keep arrangements on record if there is a disagreement. Use the chat to agree on a time and place; the handover codes do the rest.

codes.q: How do the handover codes work?
codes.a: The sender gives the pickup code to the traveller when handing over the parcel, and the recipient gives the delivery code on arrival. Share a code only at the handover itself. Each code works once and locks after several wrong attempts.

data.a: Only our verification team. They are used to confirm who you are and are never shown to other users.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms explain how Mersal works and what senders, travellers and Mersal each commit to.

service.title: The service
service.body:
Mersal is an online platform that connects people who want to send a parcel (senders) with people who already plan to travel on the same route (travellers). Mersal is not a carrier: the traveller carries the parcel, and Mersal provides matching, payment, tracking and support.

Mersal is operated by [company name, legal form and registered address].

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.body: You must be at least 18 years old and give accurate information. Travellers must complete identity verification before carrying a parcel. You are responsible for keeping your login details safe and for everything done from your account.

parcels.title: Parcels
parcels.body:
Senders must describe the contents truthfully, declare their value and never send prohibited items. Travellers may refuse a parcel that doesn’t match its description or photos.

Senders and travellers must each respect the customs rules of the countries concerned.

payments.title: Price and payment
payments.body:
The sender pays the full price when confirming a shipment. Mersal holds the payment until delivery is confirmed with the recipient’s code. The price includes Mersal’s service fee.

The traveller’s earnings become available {holdHours} hours after delivery when no problem has been reported, and are paid out weekly to the payout account they have set up.

cancellations.title: Cancellations
cancellations.body:
A sender can cancel until the parcel is picked up and is refunded in full. If no traveller is found, the sender can choose new dates or cancel for a full refund.

A traveller can withdraw from a parcel before pickup. Withdrawals lower the traveller’s reliability score.

disputes.title: Problems and disputes
disputes.body:
A sender can report a problem within {disputeHours} hours of delivery, or earlier if the parcel is late or hasn’t been delivered. The traveller’s earnings are frozen while Mersal reviews the case.

Mersal may refund the sender in full or in part, or release the earnings to the traveller, and explains its decision to both.

liability.title: Cover and liability
liability.body: Parcels are covered up to their declared value, within the limits of the cover chosen at checkout [amounts and conditions to be defined]. Mersal is not liable for indirect losses or for items sent in breach of these terms.

conduct.title: Conduct
conduct.body: Users must treat each other with respect, keep arrangements on the platform and never use Mersal for illegal purposes. Mersal may suspend accounts that break these rules.

law.title: Applicable law
law.body: These terms are governed by [applicable law]. Disputes fall under [competent courts], without prejudice to consumer protection rules.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: What personal data Mersal collects, why, and the rights you have over it under the GDPR.

controller.title: Who is responsible
controller.body: The data controller is [company name and registered address]. For any question about your data, write to [privacy contact email].

data.title: Data we collect
data.body:
Account data: name, email address, phone number and preferred language. For travellers: identity document and selfie. Shipment data: route, parcel description and photos, recipient name and phone number. Messages exchanged in a shipment’s chat. Payment status and payout details. Technical data such as IP address and device type, for security.

Card numbers are handled by our payment provider, Stripe, and are never stored by Mersal.

purposes.title: Why we use it
purposes.body:
To provide the service (quotes, matching, payments and delivery), to verify identities and prevent fraud, to handle disputes, to send service messages and to meet our legal and accounting obligations.

We rely on the contract with you, on our legal obligations, and on our legitimate interest in keeping the platform secure. We don’t sell personal data or use it for third-party advertising.

sharing.title: Who we share it with
sharing.body: The other party of a shipment sees only what is needed to complete it, such as first name, verification status and rating. Our processors act on our instructions: hosting, payments (Stripe), email and text messaging [and identity verification provider].

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: Account data is kept while your account is open. Identity documents are deleted [period] after the verification decision. Payment and accounting records are kept for the period required by law. Chat messages are kept for [period] after delivery so that disputes can be handled.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body:
You can access, correct, export or delete your data, object to or restrict some processing, and withdraw your consent at any time. Some records must be kept for legal reasons even after your account is closed.

You can also complain to your data protection authority (the CNIL in France).

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: Mersal only uses cookies the service needs: session cookies that keep you signed in, and preferences such as your language. We use no advertising or tracking cookies.

security.title: Security
security.body: Passwords are stored as salted hashes, sessions use short-lived tokens, and identity documents are only accessible to the verification team. Sensitive actions are recorded in an audit log.
